svg.text: PyTorch-embedded Tile DSL - Device IR - AOT Autotuning - Triton/CuTe/TileIR - pytorch.org/blog/helion
L1 - Applications + Integration (PyTorch-native ML kernels with tile loops)
L2 - Python DSL Frontend (PyTorch with tiles - or higher-level Triton)
Subdivide m x n iteration space into tiles
Outer loop maps to grid - inner loop to device loop
Inside hl.tile loops: compiled to single GPU kernel
Implicit masks optimized away when safe
L3 - Frontend Analysis (Python AST - type propagation - host/device partition)
L4 - Device IR + Compiler Passes (FX SSA graphs - Inductor-linked nodes - semantic transforms)
One FX graph per basic block of program
Each node points to Inductor IR node for codegen
torch ops lowered via TorchInductor to Triton
Reduction rolling: persistent to looped reduction
Loop reorder - PID shuffle for L2 reuse
Implicit mask elimination when provably safe
Per-op indexing list for load/store granularity
Auto stride/index - eviction policy per load
TMA requires Hopper+ and recent Triton
l2_groupings reorder PIDs for cache locality
Auto grid size from tile sizes + loop orders
L5 - AOT Autotuning Engine (implicit search space - thousands of Triton variants per kernel)
config= hardcode for prod - skip re-autotune
H100 sm90 pretuned heuristics as seeds
Optional autotune_dataset telemetry for ML cost model
L6 - Codegen Backends + Runtime (config applied at final codegen - kernel cache per signature)
Device IR + Config - Triton Python source
CUTLASS CuTe DSL emit - bypass Triton path
PyTorch ops to low-level Triton templates
Cache keyed by tensor signature + config
L7 - Target Hardware (NVIDIA primary - AMD/Intel via Triton - performance portable)
Config deferred to final codegen - parse/IR runs once - autotune explores config space cheaply
Stage 1 Parse: Python AST - type propagation - host/device partition - metadata annotation
Stage 2 Device IR: FX SSA graphs per basic block - Inductor IR node links - make_fx trace
Stage 3 IR Passes: reduction rolling - loop reorder - mask elimination - semantic transforms
Stage 4 Autotune: build config space - benchmark each - DifferentialEvolution/LFBO pick best
Stage 5 Codegen+Launch: Device IR + helion.Config - Triton/CuTe/TileIR - compile - cache - run
Example matmul: for tile_m,tile_n in hl.tile([m,n]) - acc=torch.addmm - out[tile_m,tile_n]=acc
Design Position: PyTorch with Tiles above Triton
Write algorithm in PyTorch - compiler handles tiling, indexing, masking, and HW tuning
l2_groupings - warp_specialize - unroll - persistent - reduction_loops - eviction
Design Position (Meta/PyTorch kernel DSL - raise abstraction above Triton while matching hand-tuned perf)
PyTorch ops + hl.tile loops - TorchInductor lowering - massive implicit autotune - Triton/CuTe/TileIR backends
Init: @helion.kernel() - first call autotunes (~10 min) - lock config= for prod - HELION_AUTOTUNE_EFFORT=none for dev
